chapter_seo_title: Eight-Nine Arcane Art Tested: Ji Ning Strolls Through a Thunder Forbidden Zone
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning completes the third cycle of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art and returns to the Quya Mountain treasure ground. In a jaw-dropping display of his new body, he walks through lethal lightning bare-handed while a Celestial Immortal watches in awe.
og_title: Ji Ning’s Body Is Now Harder Than Thunder
og_description: Back from Mount Innerheart, Ji Ning strolls through a forbidden lightning barrier as if it were a gentle rain, stunning both a Demon King and a Celestial Immortal. The Eight-Nine Arcane Art is no joke.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Makes a Celestial Immortal Call Him “Uncle-Master”
twitter_description: The third cycle of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art turns Ji Ning into a human treasure—lightning can’t scratch him, and even a veteran Celestial Immortal has to show respect.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme divine ability below the True God level in the Three Realms; trains the body to rival an Immortal-ranked treasure through nine cycles of refinement, requiring enormous resources but providing passive, cost-free defense.

A Celestial Immortal and Mount Innerheart disciple recruited by the Golden-Furred Bear King to help conquer the thunder forbidden zone; instantly recognizes Ji Ning’s Eight-Nine Arcane Art and defers to him as an uncle-master.

An Empyrean God managing the Palace of Immortals on Mount Innerheart; lent Ji Ning a hundred Immortal-ranked pills for the Eight-Nine Arcane Art, executing a shrewd social transaction that recovers his full investment.
The pocket dimension world containing Mount Innerheart, home to Patriarch Subhuti’s disciples; outsiders cannot enter without permission.

A one-hundred-eighty-zhang barrier within the Quya Mountain treasure ground that unleashes lethal lightning bolts; forces that rival high-Celestial Immortal attacks appear beyond one hundred sixty zhang.
The foundational transformation ability unlocked upon mastering the first insight of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art; allows the user to change form freely.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was Celestial Immortal Wuyai so terrified when he realized Ji Ning had the Eight-Nine Arcane Art?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Mount Innerheart’s hierarchy, the Eight-Nine Arcane Art can only be taught personally by the Patriarch or with his explicit permission; possessing it means Ji Ning is an official direct disciple, making him Wuyai’s senior regardless of age or cultivation level.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Ji Ning’s body become so tough so fast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art’s third cycle was the breakthrough, but it consumed ninety-nine Immortal-ranked pills. The art uses enormous resource input to permanently restructure the cultivator’s physical matter at a fundamental level, granting passive body-hardening that doesn’t consume divine power.
